note: Rolling spread%/depth-imbalance samples per pair, one entry appended per 15m cycle from ccxt indodax.fetchOrderBook. Used by scalper to approximate a 'spread vs recent average' signal, since this loop samples every 15 minutes rather than continuously (scalper's rules assume sub-minute monitoring — this is a proxy, not true tick-level tape reading). Keeps last 50 samples per pair (~12.5h).
